enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Move arm. Shift legs. Turn head. Breathe in. Breathe out. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap.
Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Pick up pan. Put pan on stove. Turn on stove. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing work items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Put wallet in bag. Put phone in bag. Pick up keys.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, seeing patients and completing clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Pick up patient list. Walk to patient room 101. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check patient's blood pressure. Check patient's temperature. Record vital signs in chart. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to nurses station. Update patient records. Answer phone call. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch. Walk to patient room 102. Check patient's blood pressure.

Change out of scrubs. Walk out of hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Board bus. Tap transit card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Put pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Put plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plate. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Pick up glass. Place glass in dishwasher. Pick up utensils. Place utensils in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Pick up sponge. Apply soap to sponge. Wipe counter. Rinse sponge. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Take out trash. Put new trash bag.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and checking phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Sit on bed. Check messages. Browse social media. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe in. Breathe out. Turn to right side. Move arm. Shift legs. Turn head. Breathe in. Breathe out. Remain still. Sleep.
